description: This file defines a React component 'ViewKeyTable' responsible for displaying and managing a table of API keys or tokens, including features such as delete, regenerate, and display modals for key details. It integrates with various hooks and external components, handling user interactions and state management related to key operations.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles the confirmation process to delete a key via network call and state update.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Resets delete confirmation states and closes delete modal.

methods.name: handleRegenerateClick
methods.description: Prepares state and form data to regenerate a selected key.

methods.name: handleRegenerateFormChange
methods.description: Updates form data state when user modifies the regenerate key form.

methods.name: handleRegenerateKey
methods.description: Validates and submits the regenerate key form, calls API, updates key list, and shows success/error notifications.
